title: File control: READ, STARTBR, READNEXT and READPREV in the INTO form with DATASET, LENGTH and KEYLENGTH over a seeded KSDS; NOTFND (RESP2 80) and ENDFILE (RESP2 90)

scenarios.summary: READ DATASET INTO LENGTH KEYLENGTH(4) of K130 (NORMAL, LENGTH 16), of the absent K135 (NOTFND RESP2 80) and of the last record K150
STARTBR DATASET KEYLENGTH(4) GTEQ of the absent K115 positions on K120; READNEXT INTO returns K120..K150 with LENGTH 16 and RIDFLD updated each time, then ENDFILE RESP2 90; ENDBR DATASET
STARTBR DATASET KEYLENGTH(4) GTEQ of K140; READPREV INTO returns K140..K110 with LENGTH 16 and RIDFLD updated each time, then ENDFILE RESP2 90; ENDBR DATASET
